Whether this call actually leaves a docked panel open (i.e., whether `scenePanelOpen` only governs the narrow-screen overlay and is ignored by the docked presentation) depends on `sceneLayoutLogic`'s own implementation, which is not part of the provided patch or shown surrounding code, so this can't be confirmed from what's given.

`ResourceTransferLogicProps` remains `{ resourceKind: string; resourceId: string }` — no short-id field was added. This is a separate API lookup keyed off the numeric id already present, not the navigation itself carrying the short identifier alongside the numeric one.

Whether that helper falls back to the insights list URL when the short id is null, as opposed to some other/broken URL, is determined by code not shown in the patch.

The identifier-fetch is gated to Insight only — `if (logicProps.resourceKind !== 'Insight') { return }` in the `afterMount` block — so non-insight kinds get no extra fetched identifier, satisfying the 'no extra identifier parameter' half. But whether the Back link for Dashboard/Survey still resolves via numeric id depends on the unseen `sourceResourceUrl.ts` implementation, which isn't included in the patch.

result:
Duplicating an insight on a narrow screen left the actions sidebar open over the new copy. That panel is absolutely positioned until the main column is 1200px wide, and its open state lives on the shared scene layout, so navigating to the duplicate did not dismiss it. After a successful duplicate that opens the new insight, the sidebar now closes.

The transfer page Back link built an insight URL from the route’s numeric id. Insight pages load by short id, so that link opened an insight that does not exist. The transfer scene now loads the insight by numeric id (basic payload) and the Back link uses the same short-id insight URL used elsewhere. Until that short id is known, Back goes to the insights list instead of a numeric id.

In a narrow subscriptions modal, the empty-state card kept the illustration in a row beside the text. The featured empty state is now a container: it stacks by default and only sits the illustration beside the text once the card is wide enough.

Tests: insight duplicate asserts the actions sidebar closes; the transfer back-link helper asserts a short id is used and a numeric id is not.
